text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here it is, the JBC Classic! A 
formidable lineup of dirt powerhouses has 
gathered!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
First, this Umamusume. At one point— her 
future prospects were thought to be in 
jeopardy.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
I feared things would keep going downhill 
from here. However, at the Mile 
Championship Nambu Hai—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She showed us her bright smile for the 
first time in a long while. That Umamusume 
was—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Transcend!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, looks like they totally figured out 
I was stuck in a rut. But still...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now! There's no hesitation left 
in me!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And the next Umamusume to appear is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, everyone! Chant along with me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Here we go—J-B-C♪

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —I'm looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon and Furioso! Today's race is 
shaping up to be a clash between these 
three Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Furio. Today, there's something 
I'd love to dig a little deeper into, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Dig deeper... you say?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yep. That is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Feelings toward a precious place.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I might've only had a vague 
understanding. But now...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can really savor it. Without 
losing to Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Without losing... There's no way that's 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
My feelings for Funabashi run deeper than 
anyone's, after all.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose. No matter where 
Transcend-san's feelings lie, or how 
strong they are...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, look at that hometown pride. Is 
this like a giant gathering of budding 
local idols today?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, in that case, let's all have fun 
clashing our feelings together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Regardless of the race's outcome, before, 
she couldn't match Furioso in 'hometown 
pride.' But..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Today, anything can happen." With 
unwavering resolve in her heart, Transcend 
takes on Furioso and the others in a 
rematch.
